measurement: t0 = time.perf_counter() immediately BEFORE search_algorithm.search(...); elapsed measured immediately after
INCLUDES: CVI evaluation of the SELECTED metrics per trial
critical_consequence: the historical runtime does NOT contain utility prediction, so adding reranker overhead to it cannot double-count utility time -- but the resulting total is likewise NOT end-to-end

companion_fields.fit_predict_sec: profiler total, only when a profiler was attached
companion_fields.cvi_eval_sec: profiler total, only when a profiler was attached

double_counting_prevention: the reranker consumes the SAME utility vector the policy resolver already produced for its Top-K mask; no second utility prediction is performed, and none is counted on either side
